en.html:
Horigoe Palace, Izu Province.

I sat before breakfast in a room facing the garden.

They said the Izu Peninsula was blessed with food from both mountain and sea. Looking at the number of dishes, where was I to insert a doubt? Nothing showy about the arrangement, yet all that colour.

I was hungry. I was not worried about poison—after showing them my sleeping face, such precautions would be absurd. Still, I could not decide where to put my chopsticks.

Too many dishes. My appetite had lost its nerve.

Bhook lagi hai. Hungry. A simple condition, normally cured by food. They had supplied so much of the cure that the condition was now becoming complicated. Choose this dish, and all the other dishes would still be there, being equally correct choices. My chopsticks hovered. Two sticks, one mouth, and somehow I had made a problem requiring a committee.

<ruby>伊豆國<rt>いずのくに</rt></ruby>、堀越御所。

　庭に面した一間で、朝食の卓と向き合っている。

　伊豆半島は山海の幸に恵まれていると聞くが、この
品目の多さを見るに、疑念を差し入れる余地は欠片も
無さそうであった。
　気負いのない自然な膳立てにしてこの彩りは凄い。

　空腹であり、毒飼を危ぶんでいるわけでもないのに
――寝顔を晒した後でそんな警戒は馬鹿馬鹿しい――
箸の付け所に迷ってしまう。
　皿の豊富さにこちらが気負けして、目移りするのだ。

Chachamaru"See, this is what apun is saying. Those white people suddenly making all this noise—don't catch whales, don't catch whales—who reduced the whales to almost nothing in the first place? Tum log!"
Chachamaru"Our whaling in Yamato did not wreck the ecosystem. We did not have the ships or the technique to catch that many. And one whale got used so thoroughly that a village could put its feet up for six months."
Chachamaru"Small island country. There wasn't that much demand. Who had the demand, haan? Who caught and caught all over the world's oceans, and still it wasn't enough?"
Chachamaru"You lot! Whale oil for your lamps, however much you could get! You one-legged Captain Ahabs nearly finished the whales yourselves!!"

en.html:
Agreeing with this was difficult. Arguing also, difficult.

Yamato too had used whale oil for lighting and as a pesticide in earlier times. Quite a number of whales it had taken. Since this century began, into Antarctic waters also it had gone, joining in the overhunting.

Europe had the longer history of overhunting, certainly. But...

For now, the soy-simmered whale I reached for.
Delicious.

Chachamaru"Lately they've even started this: whales are intelligent, so killing them is barbaric. Arre, then analyse that intelligence, work out how to talk to it, and tell Mr. Whale—"
Chachamaru"'I am your friend.' I'll bet you, Mr. Whale will have a few questions he cannot keep to himself."
Kageaki"...It is certainly a strange argument. Do not kill it because it is intelligent."
Chachamaru"Cow and pig: stupid, please eat. Whale: clever, absolutely not. Yeh kya logic hai? What the hell are they saying?"
Kageaki"A difference in ideas arising from a difference in culture, perhaps?"
Chachamaru"At the root, maybe racial superiority. For them, the superior creature being worth more than the inferior one is a familiar kind of justice. Supported their whole history of conquest, no?"
Kageaki"...I see."

Chachamaru"Huh. Stupid business. Apun does not discriminate. Cow, pig, whale—equal treatment. Eat them all."
Chachamaru"Dolphins too. Which reminds me, some Yamato people also make me furious. All for whaling, but mention eating dolphin and they go 'Ehhh?'"
Chachamaru"Dolphin I eat, kya problem hai?! Whale okay, dolphin not okay—then what bloody difference between YOU and the anti-whaling crowd!"
Chachamaru"Personally, I reckon they are agents sent in by the opposition."
Kageaki"...Emotionally, I can understand finding dolphin meat difficult to accept."
Chachamaru"Anti-whaling is emotional also. Finally it comes down to what you do with somebody else's culture."
Chachamaru"You don't like it, so everyone must hear your complaint? If they come to your door and force it on you, alag baat. Otherwise over there they are doing it. Leave them be. Adult person can manage that much, no?"
Kageaki"Respect for other cultures. On that, I agree entirely."
Chachamaru"Exactly, na?"

茶々丸「ふん、馬鹿くせぇってーの。 　あては差別なんかしないもんね。牛も豚も 鯨も平等に食う」
茶々丸「イルカだって食うぞ。 　それで思い出したけど一部の大和人がまた 腹立つんだよなー。捕鯨は賛成なのにイルカ 食うって聞くと『えー』とか言いやがんの」
茶々丸「イルカ食って悪いかオラ！ 　つーか鯨はいいけどイルカはだめとか言い 出したら捕鯨反対派と同レベルだろーが！」
茶々丸「あてが思うに、奴らは反対派が送り込んだ 工作員だな」
景明「……感情として、イルカ食を受け入れ難い のは理解できます」
茶々丸「捕鯨反対だって感情問題やん。 　結局のところ、自分とは違う他人の文化を どう受け止めるかって話だ」
茶々丸「気に食わないからって文句つけるか？ 　自分とこへ押し売りに来たってんならとも かく、よそでやってる分には構わずにおくの が大人の態度ってもんだろ」
景明「他文化の尊重。 　それは全く同意できます」
茶々丸「でしょーっ？」
